session_read: Pre-open, gate STABILIZING -- a genuinely calm morning (VIX -1.1%, SMH +1.0%, all three Asia terms inside 1%). Book made a new total-book high ($41,526) on two overnight adds (NBIS +2sh, LITE re-entry +1sh, both email-confirmed). The day's real tension is AVGO downgraded to WATCH the same session CIEN was upgraded to STRENGTHENING -- the strategist read both against each other rather than trading them mechanically, and skipped a stale CIEN-AMAT rotation pair whose sell leg the upgrade had just invalidated. Scorecard stayed weak (21.4% overall, n=28), so this run's three trims are sized at computed values with no discretionary top-up, and a GOOG catalyst_threat was held rather than actioned on a single-sourced, self-admittedly uncorroborated claim running against a verified thesis.
